title: Cultural Compass: A Framework for Organizing Societal Norms to Detect Violations in Human-AI Conversations
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark evaluates violations of cultural norms, using norms related to religious practices (e.g., prayer rituals in Arabic cultures) as an example of a high-stakes, offensive violation.
findings: The paper uses the violation of religious norms, such as prayer rituals, as a key example of tangible and highly offensive consequences of model misbehavior. However, it does not provide quantitative findings specific to religion, focusing instead on broader cultural norm violations across different countries and contexts.
